question: What obligation does the mantrin have regarding self-protection and all prior acts?
premises: The mantrin is the prescribed agent of the action.
Self-protection and all similar acts are included in the scope.
The manner of performance follows what was done before.
inference: Therefore the mantrin must perform self-protection and all such acts as previously established.
plain_english: The mantrin should perform self-protection and all such acts just as before.
